newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET- 4TH ENGLAND-NZ ONE DAY MATCH CALLED OFF.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET- 4TH ENGLAND-NZ ONE DAY MATCH CALLED OFF.

text.p: Steady rain forced the fourth one-day cricket international between England and New Zealand at Eden Park to be called off on Saturday.
The match will now be played on Sunday.

Technically, match officials could have kept the match on until around 2 p.m. (0100 GMT), allowing for a 25-over contest. But with no prospect of the rain stopping they decided to make use of the reserve day.
England lead the five-match series 2-0, having won the first two games at Christchurch and Auckland, and tied the third game in Napier last Wednesday.
New Zealand must win both Sunday's match and the final game at Wellington next Tuesday to square the series.
